title: Actions related to transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message

entities.name: UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message
entities.description: A message transmitted by the UE to provide positioning assistance information, specifically the association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG.

entities.name: ue-TxTEG-AssociationList
entities.description: An information element included in the UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message that contains the association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG.

entities.name: UL SRS Resource for positioning
entities.description: Uplink Sounding Reference Signal resource used for positioning purposes.

entities.name: Tx TEG
entities.description: Transmission Timing Error Group, used in positioning assistance.

entities.name: Association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG
entities.description: Condition where transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message is initiated to provide the association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG.

relations.description: The UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message includes the ue-TxTEG-AssociationList information element.
Transmission of UEPositioningAssistanceInfo message is initiated when the association between UL SRS Resource for positioning and Tx TEG needs to be provided.
The ue-TxTEG-AssociationList information element contains the association with UL SRS Resource for positioning.
The ue-TxTEG-AssociationList information element contains the association with Tx TEG.
